title: 18S V4 Tag Sequencing PCR Amplification and Library Prep
author: Lisa Mesrop
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rfvd3n6

steps.title: Prepare 18S V4 PCR mix
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 ml PCR tube combine 12.5 µl Q5 High‑Fidelity 2× Master Mix, 1.25 µl 10 µM 18S V4 Forward Illumina adaptor, 1.25 µl 10 µM 18S V4 Reverse Illumina adaptor, add 1–10 ng DNA template (to achieve a final template concentration of 0.04–0.4 ng/µl), and add nuclease‑free water to a total volume of 25 µl.

steps.title: Run 18S V4 PCR
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a pre‑heated thermocycler (activation temperature 98 °C) and run the Q5 High‑Fidelity cycling program as recommended by the manufacturer (refer to the BioLabs Q5 protocol for annealing and extension temperatures appropriate to your amplicon).

steps.title: AMPure bead cleanup (first PCR)
steps.instruction: Purify the 25 µl PCR product using Agencourt AMPure XP beads following the detailed bead‑based protocol.

substeps.instruction: Allow AMPure XP beads to equilibrate at room temperature for ≥30 min; vortex for 1 min before use.
Add an equal volume (1:1) of beads to the PCR product (25 µl beads to 25 µl product). Mix gently 20–30 times by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at room temperature for 10–15 min to allow DNA binding.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand for 2–5 min until the solution clears.
With the tubes on the magnet, add 200 µl freshly prepared 80 % ethanol opposite the bead pellet; incubate 30 s.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Repeat the 200 µl 80 % ethanol wash, incubate 30 s, and remove all supernatant (use a small‑volume pipette for residual ethanol).
Air‑dry the beads on the magnet for 5–8 min, avoiding over‑drying.
Remove tubes from the magnet and add TE buffer or nuclease‑free water (volume sufficient to resuspend beads, e.g., 20–30 µl). Mix 20–30 times.
Centrifuge at 280 × g for 30 s to collect the solution.
Place tubes back on the magnetic stand for 2–5 min, then transfer the clear supernatant (purified PCR product) to a new labeled tube.

steps.title: Quantify first cleanup with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit fluorometer with High‑Specificity dye: add 2 µl of purified PCR product to 189 µl of dye‑buffer mix (final volume 191 µl) and read per the instrument protocol.

steps.title: Prepare indexing PCR mix
steps.instruction: In a new 0.2 ml tube combine 12.5 µl Q5 High‑Fidelity 2× Master Mix, 2.5 µl 5 µM P5 indexed primer, 2.5 µl 5 µM P7 indexed primer, add normalized amount of the first‑PCR product (variable ng), and add nuclease‑free water to a total volume of 25 µl.

steps.title: Run indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler (pre‑heated to 98 °C) with the following profile: 98 °C 2 min (activation); 8 cycles of 98 °C 10 s denaturation, 66 °C 30 s annealing, 72 °C 30 s extension; final extension 72 °C 2 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: AMPure bead cleanup (indexed PCR)
steps.instruction: Purify the indexed PCR product using the same AMPure XP bead protocol described in step 3.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate beads at room temperature ≥30 min; vortex 1 min.
Add 1:1 volume of beads to the 25 µl indexed PCR product; mix 20–30×.
Wash twice with 200 µl 80 % ethanol (30 s incubation each) and remove supernatant.
Resuspend beads in TE or nuclease‑free water, mix 20–30×.
Centrifuge 280 × g 30 s, re‑magnetize 2–5 min, and transfer the clear supernatant (cleaned indexed product) to a new tube.

steps.title: Quantify indexed product with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the cleaned indexed PCR using the Qubit: add 2 µl of product to 198 µl of High‑Specificity dye‑buffer mix (final volume 200 µl) and read according to the instrument instructions.

steps.title: Normalize libraries to 10 nM
steps.instruction: Convert each library’s concentration from ng/µl to nM using (ng/µl) × 10⁶ ÷ (660 × library size in bp). Dilute each library to a common 10 nM concentration (or the concentration requested by the sequencing facility) using the equation C₁V₁ = C₂V₂.

steps.title: Pool normalized libraries
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 µl from each 10 nM library into a single tube to create the final pooled library for sequencing.
